criteria.requirement: Repair isoparser._calculate_weekdate to verify the calculated date actually belongs to requested ISO year/week, rejecting invalid W53 rather than rolling into next ISO year. Keep valid 53-week years and Gregorian-boundary dates, basic/extended syntax, default weekday, date bounds and existing day/week validation. Do not blanket-reject week 53 or compare Gregorian year in place of ISO year.
